Name: Boss Battle
Author: Akatsuki718
Description:
[heading]Boss Battle 0.12.1 (English)[/heading]
The mine entrance elevator leads to six boss arenas. Select [b]Boss Floors[/b], choose a destination, and take on the fight solo or with friends. In co-op, players in the same arena share the fight. Each participating farmer still in the arena at victory earns a reward based on their own clear history.
Boss Battle is currently in beta, with more bosses planned.
[b]Slime King[/b] — Dodge the two knights’ charges and watch where the king lands after each leap. Your first victory earns the Slime Scepter. In single-player, use it to summon the two knights to fight alongside you or help with chopping trees, breaking rocks, and clearing debris.
[b]Bat Lord[/b] — Watch for dives, sound waves, and bat swarms. Your first victory earns the Echo Necklace. Equip it in the hat slot to use sonar to locate forage, artifact spots, and mine ladders. Sonar can also reveal buried caches for you to dig up with your hoe.
[b]Void Squad[/b] — Face the Void Brute, Void Marksman, and Void Shaman together. Each time one falls, the survivors enter their next phase. Your first victory earns the Void Core. Hold and use it to unlock Void Travel, Void Ward, and Void Shockwave.
[b]Crystalback Crab[/b] — Choose the Crystal Seam Chamber, follow the tracks north, then turn right into the quarry. Strike the large crystal three times with your pickaxe to awaken the crab. When it drops an ice crystal and a chunk of iron ore, break one to determine which shell it takes. Your first victory earns the Mine Crab Whistle. The little crab can carry up to 12 stacks of items back to your farm, once per farmer per day.
[b]Sandworm Empress[/b] — Enter the Ancient Sand Nest and step onto the central emblem to challenge the Empress. Use the pillars to block her venom, dodge the vortex and rock spikes, then strike when she collapses. Your first victory earns the Sandsong Flute, 5 Empress Scales, and the Scale Powder recipe. On the farm, island farm, or in a greenhouse, hold the flute and press the action button facing an empty tile. Its song enriches soil treated with Scale Powder in a 5×5 area around you. Crops there take 25% fewer days to grow and regrow, and yield silver to iridium quality produce.
[b]Frostveil Lantern — New in 0.12[/b]
Touch the ancient lantern in the Permafrost Sanctum to awaken the spirit. Lure it into the light of a brazier to break its shield. In the final phase, dodge the sweeping beams and relight all four braziers before the final blast. Your first victory earns the Frostsoul Lantern. Carry it to light your way and release a frost pulse when you take damage.
[b]Requirements and installation[/b]
For Stardew Valley 1.6.15. Requires SMAPI 4.1.10 or later and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later. Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0 or later is optional. Extract the [b]Boss Battle[/b] folder into your [b]Mods[/b] folder. For online co-op, the host and all farmhands need the same version.
Available in English and Simplified Chinese. Custom artwork was created with AI assistance. Feedback and bug reports are welcome!
[line]
[heading]Boss Battle 0.12.1（简体中文）[/heading]
矿井大厅的电梯可以通往六座 Boss 场地。选择**「Boss层」**，再选择目的地，即可独自挑战或与好友一同迎战。联机时，同一场地的玩家共享战斗进度。获胜时仍在场的参战农夫，按各自的首胜或再战记录领取奖励。
模组目前为测试版，后续会陆续加入更多 Boss。
[b]史莱姆王[/b] — 躲开两名骑士的冲锋，留意史莱姆王跃起后的落点。首胜可获得史莱姆权杖。单人游玩时，可以召唤这两名骑士并肩作战，也可以让它们帮忙砍树、采矿和清理杂物。
[b]蝙蝠领主[/b] — 留意领主的俯冲、声波和蝠群。首胜可获得回音项链，装备在帽子栏后即可使用声呐，探测附近的采集物、古物点和矿梯。在矿层中还有机会发现埋藏的宝箱，用声呐标出位置后，拿锄头就能挖出来。
[b]虚空小队[/b] — 同时迎战虚空狂徒、虚空狙击手和虚空萨满。每击败其中一人，幸存者就会进入下一阶段。首胜可获得虚空核心，手持并使用即可解锁虚空穿梭、虚空护体和虚空震荡。
[b]裂晶巨蟹[/b] — 在电梯选择「裂晶矿室」，沿矿轨向北，再向右进入采掘场。用镐子敲击中央的大晶石三次，即可唤醒巨蟹。它震落冰晶和铁矿石时，可以击碎其中一块，决定它接下来换上的矿壳。首胜可获得矿蟹哨，召来小矿蟹帮你运货。每位农夫每天可托运一次，一趟最多把 12 格背包物品送回农场。
[b]沙虫女皇[/b] — 进入「古代虫巢」，踏上中央纹章迎战女皇。借石柱挡住毒液，躲开龙卷风和地刺，等她力竭倒地时近身反击。首胜可获得鸣沙骨笛、5 枚女皇沙鳞和麟粉配方。在农场、温室或姜岛农场手持骨笛，面向空处按交互键即可吹奏。笛声会将周围 5×5 格内施过麟粉的耕地变为沃土。沃土上的作物生长和再生周期缩短 25%，收获品质为银星至铱星。
[b]霜帷提灯灵 — 0.12 新增[/b]
在「永冻祭坛」触碰古代冰灯，唤醒提灯灵。把它引进火盆的暖光即可破盾。三阶段躲开扫射的光束，在终爆前重新点亮四座火盆。首胜可获得霜魂提灯，随身携带即可照明，受伤时会自动释放霜魂脉冲。
[b]前置要求与安装[/b]
适用于《星露谷物语》1.6.15。需要 SMAPI 4.1.10 或更高版本，以及 Content Patcher 2.9.0 或更高版本。可选装 Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0 或更高版本，在游戏内调整设置。将压缩包中的 [b]Boss Battle[/b] 文件夹解压到游戏的 [b]Mods[/b] 文件夹。远程联机时，房主和每位队友都需要安装相同版本。
支持英文和简体中文。自定义美术素材使用了 AI 辅助制作。欢迎反馈游玩体验和遇到的问题！

Downloads.Description:
Six boss encounters in beta, solo or co-op: Slime King, Bat Lord, Void Squad, Crystalback Crab, Sandworm Empress, and Frostveil Lantern. More bosses are planned.

目前为测试版，可单人或联机挑战史莱姆王、蝙蝠领主、虚空小队、裂晶巨蟹、沙虫女皇和霜帷提灯灵。后续会陆续加入更多 Boss。
